title: Sequence order loss
summary: A meaningful progression collapses into independent items, so stage order and checkpoints are no longer visible.

rendered_symptoms: the checkpoint is detached from the stage it governs
not_sufficient_evidence: a reviewer preference for horizontal rather than vertical flow

actions: attach conditions and checkpoints to the governed stage
verification: stage order is readable without relying on body copy
the checkpoint has an unambiguous governed stage
stop_conditions: do not invent missing stage order
do not connect unrelated objects with decorative arrows
